name: unique_orientation
expr: [u, ia, ic] = unique(rv); ur = double(isrow(u)); iac = double(iscolumn(ia)); icc = double(iscolumn(ic)); ia1 = ia(1); ic1 = ic(1); nia = numel(ia); nic = numel(ic); [uc, iac2, icc2] = unique(cv); ucc = double(iscolumn(uc)); iac2c = double(iscolumn(iac2)); s1 = double(iscolumn(unique(cv))); s2 = double(isrow(unique(rv)));
comment: unique output orientation vs MATLAB R2025b. Bug fixed 2026-05-30: ia/ic came back as row vectors and u was always a row even for a column input. MATLAB: ia and ic are ALWAYS column vectors (iac=icc=1); u matches the input orientation (row input -> row u so ur=1 and s2=1; column input -> column u so ucc=1 and s1=1). Values unchanged (ia(1)=2, ic(1)=3, nia=3, nic=5). namespace=builtin.
